title: Start where ego is finally questioned
summary: The line refuses to let self-importance dress itself as honesty, intelligence, or force. Let this stay near the next choice: hold onto this: treat ego as illness and keep the Guru's medicine near.
takeaway: Interrogate the voice before you obey it.
lifeApplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, pause and refuse to grant ego the status of truth.

source.shortMeaning: Ego loosens when it is examined instead of instinctively defended.
source.lifeApplication: When defensiveness rises, ask where ego came from before speaking from it.
